params.warmup_scope: No discarded samples. Identical source/dependency pre-read before every sample; diagnostic compilation is separate from this target-build population.
params.invalidation: mtime only; source bytes remain at the exact clean commit; require observed importer fan-out
params.build_storage: Fresh owned build at /dev/shm/intrinsic-build010-measure; identical source/build paths across all arms.
params.dependency_state: identical preinstalled vcpkg packages, no package installation during sampling
params.operating_system_cache: input pre-read, no cache flushing, no cold-filesystem claim
params.memory_measurement: GNU time maximum single-process RSS, not aggregate concurrent memory
params.critical_path: Ninja target DAG weighted by unfiltered per-invocation timings; unmatched meta-edges reported
params.summary: Median and range of two samples per arm. Acceptance requires >=2% clean improvement or >=3% and >=0.5s representative consumer improvement, nonoverlapping improved arm ranges, and <=2% clean regression. All owner costs and negative results retained. Not a full-engine or statistical claim.
params.sample_sequence: Configure, clean build, no-op, mesh/clustering consumer edits, scene-serialization edit, shared property implementation edit. Fresh build per sample, mtime-only edits.
params.noise_scope: Normal desktop host; no CPU affinity/governor/turbo control. No competing compilation or tests; source inspection and remote review may run. Local descriptive comparison, not an isolated-machine or statistical claim.
params.configure_measurement: initial configure only; source iteration cohort deliberately excludes the already-measured reconfigure scenario.
params.source_scope: Clean exact before and after commits. Only canonical property instantiation source, its behavior tests and documentation differ; test consumers are unchanged. Local descriptive evidence, not publication-qualified.
